The matrix's own output line is NOT quotable from that log (the log is truncated before the build and uji per-file lines); the count is the evidence that the suite ran: the same tree gave 778/778 locally with scripts/uji/calculator-adversarial-matrix.mts, (the count without that file was not measured, so this shows the run size, not the file by itself). What the suite does: scripts/uji/calculator-adversarial-matrix.mts attacks all 47 registry engines (57 adapters because call signatures and exported calculators differ) with 2026 runs: NaN, undefined, '', Infinity, -Infinity, negative, one step below/above the declared range, unit text ('70 mg/dL') and numeric text ('70') on every numeric input, plus categorical and yes/no probes. It requires a named rejection reason, no finite number in a rejected result (declared partials only), distinct reasons per field, boundary-accept pairs (exact min and max and real booleans are accepted) and a registry-coverage assertion (an engine without an adapter fails). Fail-open paths it found and that were fixed in the same PR: non-boolean yes/no input read as 'no' or by truthiness in stopBang, news2, sofaScore, meldNa and hydrationTarget; sleepDebt returned ok:true with a critical verdict for a night with blank hours. Negative controls on the real engines, each reported by name and reverted: MAP systolic range check removed; isFiniteNumber coercing numeric text (numeric-text accepted across engines); stopBang boolean guard reverted; sleepDebt night guard reverted; built-in self-tests classify an object-for-NaN engine, an empty reason, a thrown error and a number-carrying rejection. NOT shown: the matrix attacks the fields listed per adapter, so a new input field not added to an adapter is not attacked (a new engine without an adapter does fail); it proves bad input is refused with a reason, not that any accepted value, range or cut-off is clinically right; clinically_reviewed stays false for every engine; sleepDebt calendar-impossible dates (2026-02-30) are still accepted. Details: docs/governance/CALCULATOR_ADVERSARIAL_MATRIX.md.
